name: Termitomyces titanicus

ecology.substrate: plant matter chewed by termites, on the comb inside the mound

size_cm.note: cap to about 100 cm across, stalk to 57 cm; upper limits only, no lower bound given

notes: The largest gilled mushroom, described only in 1980, from West Africa, Zambia and DR Congo [27]. Reported (unchecked): the comb sits inside the mound with a long root-like stalk to the surface, and the termites hold the mound interior near constant warmth.
